state-block.comment: Block title: '# ' + state name (case-insensitive) + optional trailing whitespace, RFC §6.1
state-block.name: markup.heading.state-block.stanza

continuation-line.comment: Indented non-blank line: task note, no metadata parsed inside, RFC §7.3
continuation-line.name: comment.block.notes.stanza

task-header.comment: Any unindented non-blank line that is not a block title starts a new task, RFC §7.1
task-header.name: meta.task-header.stanza

priority-with-date.comment: '(A) 2026-08-07 ': priority directly followed by due date, RFC §7.2

priority.comment: '(A) ' at line start, exactly one trailing space, RFC §7.2.1

date.comment: Due date at line start (no priority), RFC §7.2.2

project.comment: +name preceded by line start or whitespace; name = [L,N][L,N,_,-]*, RFC §7.2.4

tag.comment: #name preceded by line start or whitespace; first char must be a letter, RFC §7.2.5
